To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the degradation of intrinsic polysilicon thin film transistors under hot carrier stress is strongly influenced by the offset length, which is the distance between gate and channel.
hot-carrier degradation is more pronounced in offset gated TFTs than in non-offset devices and that the degree of degradation is dependent on the gate offset length.
hot carriers cause the reduction of on-state current, the shift of transfer characteristics, and the formation of kink in the subthreshold characteristics in offset gated n-channel TFTs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the hot carrier effects in offset gated polysili-con thin-film transis-tors.
the study of the degradation of polysilicon TFTs due to the effects of hot carriers.
the study of the degradation of offset gated polysilcon TFTs due to hot carrier effects.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the offset gate structure is a useful tool for improving the hot carrier immunity of polysilicon thin film transistors.

the offset length has to be as short as possible to minimize the hot carrier induced device degradation, and that a gate offset of 0.5 μm is sufficient to suppress the kink effect in polysilicon TFTs.
offset gating is a viable approach to suppress the degradation of polysilicon thin film transistors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
hot carrier effects in offset gated TFTs are more pronounced than in conventional devices.
the device degradation in offset gated TFTs is mainly caused by the hot carriers in the offset region.
the hot-carrier-induced degradation in offset gated devices can be explained by the presence of a parasitic channel in the offset region, which is activated by the hot carriers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the offset gated device is a promising alternative for the conventional TFT, especially in the case where the device degradation due to hot carriers is a major concern.
the gate offset length plays a key role in the device degradation and that the device degradation can be minimized if the offset length is chosen appropriately.
the gate offset is a key design parameter for hot carrier reliability in TFTs.
